notes: §1985:XI.4.2.3 SR3 (amended): 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area.' SortBinder.BindRelease hands the FROM operand to MoveBinder.BindFromPhrase, which asks StatementValidation.CheckPhraseOperandIsNotRecordArea (StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf, RecordAreaRule.InForce: Year < 2023; COBOL6827) and screens the function category against FromPhraseRules.Release (COBOL1914). Function sentence holds at 85: LENGTH and INTEGER refused; UPPER-CASE and MAX of alphanumeric arguments run ([ABCD], [cd  ]); NATIONAL-OF is COBOL1502, so the row's national widening is unreachable. Storage sentence holds for the sort record (the witness), another 01 of the SD and a whole-record subordinate (SORT-KEY), all COBOL6827, but RELEASE SORT-REC FROM SORT-REC(1:4) and FROM SORT-E(1) (01 SORT-T. 05 SORT-E OCCURS 1 TIMES PIC X(4), the whole area) compile and run: IsRecordAreaOf answers false for any reference-modified or subscripted operand (docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D31(b)), though each references the identical storage. Probe classes: a (ref-mod at 1:4), b (each storage shape, numeric functions), c (FROM literal COBOL0871, NATIONAL-OF COBOL1502), d (group, elementary, alphanumeric and numeric functions), e (SD with INPUT/OUTPUT procedures, RETURN after the RELEASE); f does not reach this syntax rule. kb/Work PB5412 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-02.json).

next.reason: Amended text (X3.23a-1989 added the function sentence, errata C153; X3.23b-1993 made the second sentence unconditional again, errata C298), §1985:XI.4.2.3 SR3: 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area.' Two differences in 2023. (a) The function sentence is widened: §2023:14.9.32.3 SR2 'it shall reference an alphanumeric or national function'; 2023 accepts a national function 1985 refuses. (b) 2023 has no syntax rule refusing shared storage: §2023:14.9.32.4 GR4 makes RELEASE FROM an implicit MOVE and its NOTE says 14.6.10 and the MOVE rules 'apply to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1 and the record area associated with record-name-1 share any part of their storage areas'; the result is then §2023:14.6.10 GR2 'the same as if the data items shared no part of their respective storage areas' (same data description entry) or §2023:14.6.10 GR1 'the result of the statement is undefined'. A refusal became acceptance with a defined or undefined result; no exception condition.
